title: WoDX Targeting
description: World of Darkness Expanded: target suggestions for powers and attacks. When an action window opens and no one is targeted by hand, WoDX reads whether the power is aimed at a foe, a friend, the user or an area, and how far it reaches, then names a likely target and the next few. Automatic mode, for the Storyteller only, sets the target as the window opens. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
